title: Professional Mould Remediation Containment - IICRC Certified Brisbane Mould Removal
description: IICRC Mould Remediation certified technician establishing professional containment barriers in Brisbane property with mould growth. Specialist in full protective equipment (respirator, hazmat suit) installing plastic sheeting and HEPA air scrubbers to isolate mould-affected area. Demonstrates proper health & safety protocols for Queensland's humid climate mould issues with 25+ years expertise in safe mould removal and remediation.
